## §6 SOURCE

```
SOURCE(p) iff not excluded-dir(p) and not excluded-basename(p)
              and ext(p) in {.go .py .js .jsx .ts .tsx .mjs .cjs .java}
              and not TEST(p)
```

Excluded directory segments: `node_modules vendor third_party thirdparty
bower_components Godeps dist build out target coverage .next .venv venv
site-packages generated gen external testdata fixtures __snapshots__ .git`.

Excluded generated basenames (SOURCE only): `*.min.js *.bundle.js *.d.ts *.pb.go
*_pb.go *_generated.go *_gen.go *_pb2.py`.

## §7 TEST

`TEST` takes precedence over `SOURCE`; the roles are mutually exclusive by
construction. For this TypeScript-only cohort only rule `T-JS` fires; `T-GO`,
`T-PY` and `T-JAVA` are retained verbatim for fidelity with META-289.

```
T-JS: ext in {.js .jsx .ts .tsx .mjs .cjs}
      and ( base matches ^.+\.(test|spec)\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mjs|cjs)$
            or any dir segment in {__tests__ __test__ test tests spec specs e2e} )
```
